policy.freshness: Pinned 2026 repository snapshots are recent research evidence. They do not imply that an original prompt first appeared on the snapshot date; original dates are provided where actually known.
policy.licensing: Only clearly licensed documentation prompts are marked adapted. Secondary aggregations and unclear rights are broad inspiration for original authored mechanisms, never copied or described as authorized source material.
policy.examples: All selected examples require independently generated source photographs and real source-image edits; no upstream images are copied. This text audit claims no successful generation.
policy.deduplication: Exact slug and source-brief uniqueness is checked mechanically. Nearest-mechanism comparisons below are editorial judgments, recorded for review; palette-only variations were replaced.
policy.no_claim: This batch is 33 MIT-documented adaptations and 47 original authored research extensions, not 80 newly published or individually licensed third-party prompts.
